title: windows-common: add more NTSTATUS/WERROR codes from MS-ERREF

notes.body:
@geraldcombs 

do you known why CI fail ?

```
usage: validate-commit.py [-h] [--commitmsg COMMITMSG] [commit]
validate-commit.py: error: unrecognized arguments: 3b6eecd5
```
validate-commit.py doesn't handle multiple commits. Fix inbound in !18328.

added 4 commits
  • e85af4dd...7fda930f - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 944431c2 - windows-common: add more NTSTATUS codes from MS-ERREF
  • 2ae60b60 - windows-common: add new WERROR codes from MS-ERREF
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18326/diffs?diff_id=1200743104&start_sha=e85af4ddf7cb6d11e3aacec83dbea19f83e0abbb)

added 3 commits
  • e1ac279d - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 290d2257 - windows-common: add more NTSTATUS codes from MS-ERREF
  • 3d6faba8 - windows-common: add new WERROR codes from MS-ERREF
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18326/diffs?diff_id=1200901468&start_sha=2ae60b603ad17f29b27926469ace5de200bb35d1)
enabled an automatic merge when all merge checks for 3d6faba8d9671ea17585b6fb6186807d6ac14111 pass

These two are the same. That appears to be the case in the [MS-ERREF document](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-erref/596a1078-e883-4972-9bbc-49e60bebca55), but it causes some warnings, and in practice only one will be used by the value string. What's the best approach?

Hmm, maybe change it to `STATUS_FWP_TOO_MANY_BOOTTIME_FILTERS_OR_CALLOUTS`
in wireshark?
Can you prepare the patch? I'm busy with non-wireshark things...
No problem, thanks for the input.
